system.description:
• Frame (1st): your servant is your weapon. Hit Die d4.
  • Bound Command (1st): you have one more Bound Servant a day. Your servant adds your Charisma modifier to its attack rolls, and to the damage of one hit each round. Until 3rd level, the familiar from your Summon Familiar spell counts as your servant.
  • Free invocations (1st): Living Shield and Shared Senses.
  • Pack Hunter (7th): your servant makes one more attack when it attacks, with Disadvantage.
  • Two servants (9th): you can have two servants at once, the second at least one tier lower.
  • Each needs its own summoning and slot; both act right after you.
  • Bound Command, Pack Hunter and your Summons invocations apply to one servant of your choice each round.
  • Living Shield still works once a round.
  • Unbroken Chain (15th): once per encounter, a servant that drops rises again at half its HP.
  • Pact spells: Summon Familiar, Darkness, Fly, Dimension Door, Telepathic Bond, Animate Objects.
